shots.text: A HUMAN IS A POOR MEAL
ONE MAN, ONE FRAGMENT AT A TIME
AND THEIR TEETH TELL A STORY
AND IT STUCK FOR A CENTURY
AND MOST OF IT IS NOT MEAT
FOOD. THEN ART. THEN A CUP.
IN A POT, AND IN A PERSON
bakedWords: IN A POT, AND IN A PERSON

shots.text: THEY CALLED IT THE STARVING TIME
AND THE LABEL WAS A LICENCE
